data.name: Udham
data.gender_notes: Udham is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Udham is recorded with the meaning “Self-Rise”. Udham is a Hindu name meaning “Self-Rise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: उधम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who lifts or raises, often used as a name for a deity or a person who helps others to rise above their difficulties.

in_hindi.name: उधम
in_hindi.meaning: उद्धरण (uddharaṇa) - उद्धारना (uddhārana) - to lift, to raise
in_hindi.long_meaning: उद्धरण करना (uddharaṇa karna) - to lift, to raise, to help, to save, to rescue.

in_tamil.name: உத்தம்
in_tamil.meaning: உத்தர் (uttar) - higher, upper, superior + அம் (am) - being, existence
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is above, higher, superior in existence.

in_telugu.name: ఉద్ధమ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who lifts or raises, often used as a name for a deity or a person who helps others to rise above their difficulties.

in_marathi.name: Udham
in_marathi.long_meaning: Udham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rises from within, self-reliant and determined

in_bengali.name: Udham
in_bengali.long_meaning: Udham একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rises from within, self-reliant and determined
